facts.text: As Jenna Hulton, she was named Liberty League Runner of the Year in women's cross country in 2011, becoming only the second two-time All-American in St. Lawrence University program history after placing 34th at the 2011 NCAA Championship; her 22:04 was the fastest time ever at a Liberty League championship meet

A member of St. Lawrence University's 2009 women's cross country team, inducted into the St. Lawrence Athletics Hall of Fame in 2026; she finished 15th at the 2009 NCAA Division III Championship to earn All-America honors
Her clinical interests at Hospital for Special Surgery include caring for patients with clubfeet and neuromuscular disorders
Active member of the Pediatric Orthopedic Practitioners Society and the American Academy for Cerebral Palsy and Developmental Medicine
Listed in SUNY Canton's May 2026 commencement program as a Nursing A.A.S. degree candidate graduating Magna Cum Laude
Named to SUNY Canton's Dean's List for Spring 2026, listed as a Nursing - BS student
Finished 7th in the MA3 Recreational division at the Spring Sling Battle of Cadyville in Cadyville, New York, scoring -1 with rounds of 59 and 54 for a total of 113
As a junior attack at SUNY Potsdam in 2016, she was having a career year with 22 goals and seven assists for 29 points by early May, nearly doubling her previous best
